maps.name: MAF Calibration
maps.description: Mass Air Flow sensor transfer function (ADC step → kg/h). Promoted after sheet+XDF+legacy agreement and RedLabel binary pattern check.

evidence.detail: CAL sheet notes MAF transfer at D290; XDF title 0xD290[Func|5V|256]MAF Cal. kg/h; BROtronic legacy maf_cal — three-way offset/dims agreement (256×1, 16-bit).
0xD290 (53904) lies in DATA_CAL on RedLabel (64KB image); span 512 bytes fits before following XDF region at 0xD490.
RedLabel bytes at 0xD290 form a mostly-monotonic LE u16 transfer (≈239/255 non-decreasing steps); early samples near 0, mid-range ~50–60 kg/h via X/4.
Formula X/4 yields physical airflow in a plausible MAF kg/h band for M50 (~0–~60+ across the curve).
